{{Quote|They have podracing on Malastare. Very fast, very dangerous.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Malastare''' was the high-gravity [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the quadrupedal [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] race, on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Malastare is underdeveloped as it is, and areas like this still remain ''unmapped''.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="Dug Out" />}}
[[File:Jungle.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The jungles of Malastare]]
Malastare had a variety of terrains including forests, deserts, [[Methane/Legends|methane]] lakes, and rivers. This made the planet a favorite [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] location. There, local and interstellar stars such as the Dug [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] competed in events such as the [[Malastare 100/Legends|Malastare 100]], the [[Dug Derby/Legends|Dug Derby]], [[Sebulba's Legacy/Legends|Sebulba's Legacy]], the [[Phoebos Memorial Run/Legends|Phoebos Memorial Run]] and the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]].<ref name="SW:EIR">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
This planet had long been plagued by monstrous [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beasts]] that fed on the native Dugs. The Dugs gained the upper hand and eventually eradicated all the Zillo Beasts, when it was discovered that Malastare's natural [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] resources were toxic to them.<ref name="TCW:TZB" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the local authorities wanted to smash the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade which caused the price of spice to inflate. Due to this, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] began hiring individuals to deliver a shipment of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]].<ref name="Inflation">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Spice Inflation}}</ref>

===Gran settlement===
In circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], a contingent of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colonists settled on the planet. The first meeting between the Gran and the Dugs was bloody, and a long, brutal [[Dug-Gran conflict|war]] ensued in its aftermath. Because of the power and influence the Gran wielded in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the Republic settled the violence in the Gran's favor.<ref name="Gran in the Databank">{{DB|species|gran|Gran}}</ref><ref name="Galaxy Guide 12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

[[File:Malastare1319.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Podracing on Malastare]]
The [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] [[Gran Protectorate Act/Legends|was established]] circa 1000 BBY, and, as a consequence, the Dugs were demilitarized and stripped of political power, with the unemployed ones being relocated to the [[Malastare's western continent|western continent]] of their own planet.<ref name="TEA" />

===The fall of the Republic===
In the Galactic Republic, Malastare was represented in the Galactic Senate exclusively by Gran politicians such as [[Pax Teem]], [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]], [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]], [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]], and [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]].<ref name="TEA" /> Around [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the planet's economy was heavily dependent on both [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] and fuel exports, and its finances suffered when [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] restored a [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|spectacular course]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with the support of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], and a vast [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] source was discovered on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and was exported by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

In his quest to become the prime [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], the bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] visited Malastare in search of the crime lord [[Sebolto]], thought to be in league with the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] crime syndicate.

Malastare remained loyal to the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], its [[Senator/Legends|senators]] serving on the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]. An organization called [[Dugs-for-Democracy]] opposed the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] and fought for the civil rights of Dugs.<ref name="HNNV.531 55">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #55]]</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|What makes the Jedi Council think the Separatists are operating here? I thought the ''Dugs'' and ''Gran'' were on our side.''"<br />"''They are, but that doesn't stop the Separatists working ''quietly''.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="The Masked Racer" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the planet's vital fuel reserves captured the attention of both the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], the Separatists deployed a large droid army that overwhelmed the local Dug and Republic defenders. In response, Republic forces deployed a new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which quickly obliterated the droid forces but awakened an ancient monstrous [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]. The Zillo Beast devastated the Republic and Dug lines, resulting in heavy losses.<ref name="TCW:TZB" />

In exchange for Republic protection and access to Malastare's valuable fuel, the Dugs demanded that they destroy the Zillo Beast. However, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] secretly arranged for the beast to be stunned in order to obtain its hide for scientific research while appeasing the Dugs. It was knocked out by particle cannon fire from Republic [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tanks]].<ref name="TCW:TZB" />

[[File:Malastare_landscape.png|thumb|left|220px|The surface region of Malastare during the Clone Wars]]
With the Separatist droid forces neutralized and the Zillo Beast ostensibly eliminated, the Dugs signed their [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|treaty]] with the Republic. The unconscious beast was then taken to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galactic]] capital, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to be studied in a contained environment.<ref name="TCW:TZB" /> However, shortly after arrival, the Zillo Beast escaped and proceeded to wreak havoc, endangering the lives of millions and forcing the Jedi to eliminate it.<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=http://tv.ign.com/objects/067/067069.html|text=IGN Episode Guide|archivedate=20100411235214}}</ref> Later in the war, Malastare would again be the site of conflict through a [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|mission]]<ref name="Dug Out">{{TCWComicCite|6.19|Dug Out}}</ref> and another [[Mission to Malastare (Anakin Skywalker)|mission]].<ref name="The Masked Racer">{{SWComicCite|7.3|The Masked Racer}}</ref>

===Under the Empire===
[[File:Malastare_TEA.jpg|thumb|250px|Malastare]]
Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ozzik Sturn]] was installed as the [[Chief Magistrate (Galactic Empire)|Chief Magistrate]] of Malastare after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took over the planet. An avid hunter, he took to hunting the native [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] animals but quickly became bored. Instead, he had [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] released into a private hunting reserve, where he stalked and killed them. Though hidden, the hunting reserve was eventually discovered by the planet's native Dugs and Grans. Outraged, they revolted against Imperial rule, and the Empire suffered a high casualty rate as a result. This resulted in Ozzik Sturn being transferred to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="The Force Unleashed novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was given passage to Malastare, where he ended up recruiting several people for a new squad, including a [[Ni-Ke-Vanz|Cerean medic]] who also had some experience with cloning.

===The Galactic Civil War and after===
The system joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometime between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. It was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was [[Conquest of Malastare|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], but the invaders spared Malastare's infrastructure to establish an orbital rendezvous point for their warships.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was liberated and had senatorial representation in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], but since many worlds had suffered worse damage from the Yuuzhan Vong, the Alliance largely left the planet to rebuild on its own, to the ire of both Dugs and Gran.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
With several lines referencing it in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']] and in a deleted scene from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], Malastare is one of the most profiled planets in the ''Star Wars'' movie saga, yet never seen in any of the first six films.
